title: Change Order Allowance, Markup, Authorisation Threshold and Response Period by Class
content:
# Change Order Terms by Project Class

Every class of Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects carries four change order values: the owner-authorised change allowance credited at award as a portion of the contract value, the markup applied to the cost of change order work, the change order value above which the owner's written authorisation is required, and the number of business days within which a requested change is priced.

| Project class | Change allowance credited at award (per cent of contract value) | Markup on change order cost (per cent) | Written authorisation required above (USD) | Pricing response (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Equipment Replacement Order | 0 | 25 | 500 | 5 |
| Planned Replacement Program | 3 | 22 | 1500 | 5 |
| Controls Retrofit Project | 5 | 20 | 2500 | 7 |
| Energy Retrofit Project | 5 | 18 | 5000 | 7 |
| Turnkey Mechanical Upgrade Project | 7 | 15 | 10000 | 10 |
| Design-Build Infrastructure Program | 10 | 12 | 25000 | 10 |

## Notes on the four values

- The allowance is credited at award; an Equipment Replacement Order is credited none, because its allowance rate is 0.
- The markup is applied to the cost of the change order work; it falls as the class rises.
- The authorisation threshold is a value the change order passes: a change order of exactly the threshold value has not passed it.
- The response period is counted in business days from the day the owner asked for the change.

## Hypothetical readings

A change order priced at USD 2500 on a Controls Retrofit Project sits exactly at the class threshold of 2500 and has not passed it; the same change order at USD 2500.01 has. On a Turnkey Mechanical Upgrade Project awarded at USD 400000 the allowance credited at award is 7 per cent, USD 28000.
